What we do

Four ways to move forward.

Choose focused support for a specific challenge or work with us as your needs evolve.

01 / ORGANIZATIONS

Fractional HR

Flexible, hands-on HR support to strengthen your people operations without adding a full-time senior role.

  • HR policies & processes
  • Employee relations
  • Performance & people operations
How we help
  1. Understand your current people challenges
  2. Set priorities and an HR action plan
  3. Put policies and support into practice
02 / ORGANIZATIONS

Recruitment & Executive Search

Thoughtful sourcing and selection for specialist, professional, and leadership roles, from brief to offer.

  • Talent sourcing
  • Candidate assessment
  • Leadership search
How we help
  1. Define the role and success profile
  2. Source and assess suitable talent
  3. Support interviews and the offer
03 / PROFESSIONALS

Career Services

Practical guidance to help you tell your story, prepare with confidence, and navigate your next move.

  • Resume & LinkedIn
  • Interview preparation
  • Career coaching
How we help
  1. Clarify your goals and strengths
  2. Refine your resume and LinkedIn story
  3. Practice interviews and next steps
04 / PEOPLE & ORGANIZATIONS

Global Mobility

People-focused support for cross-border career transitions and employer mobility processes, coordinated around your goals.

  • Relocation planning
  • Transition support
  • Employer coordination
How we help
  1. Map the move and key requirements
  2. Coordinate people and employer needs
  3. Prepare for a smoother transition

About us

People-centered support with a global outlook.

FABZ HR International Inc. is registered in Toronto, Canada.

We support organizations and professionals through fractional HR, recruitment and executive search, career services, and global mobility. As we grow across borders, we remain grounded in clear guidance, practical action, and respect for every person we meet.

What guides us

Guided by People.
Grounded in Trust.

OUR MISSION

Connections that drive lasting growth.

Our mission is to help organizations build strong teams and professionals pursue meaningful careers through personalized HR solutions. We connect talent with opportunity, offer practical guidance, and deliver service that supports lasting growth across the workforce.

OUR VISION

A more open world of work.

We envision a future where organizations can find and develop the people who move them forward, and professionals can pursue meaningful careers wherever opportunity takes them. FABZ HR aims to be a trusted global partner, recognized for thoughtful and innovative people solutions.

Our Core Values

The standards behind every conversation and commitment.

  • AccountabilityOwn our commitments and follow through.
  • RespectListen and treat each person with care.
  • TransparencyCommunicate clearly about scope, progress, and expectations.
  • TrustEarn confidence through consistent, honest work.
How we work

A clear process, tailored to your goals.

Whether you need HR expertise, a key hire, career guidance, or mobility support, we define the work together and keep you informed throughout the engagement.

01
Assess your needs

We discuss the challenge, your priorities, and the outcome you need.

02
Agree on a plan

We set the scope, deliverables, timeline, and points of contact.

03
Deliver and follow through

We complete the work, share progress, and adjust the approach as needed.
